Messages.Author: cauecoraini
Messages.Body:
1. Simple question: can I  Basic Bleed with a Ravnos, play red herring, then play computer hacking with another minion? Does it not clash card text with  6.1.1 of rule book?

2.  Still, can I Basic Bleed with a minion, play red herring and then computer hacking with the same minion?

Messages.Author: cauecoraini
Messages.Body:
Relevant card texts:

Red Herring

Only usable when this acting vampire is blocked. Untap the acting vampire, do not tap the blocking minion, and cancel the current action and combat. Take the card played to perform the action (if any) back into your hand. Your vampires cannot attempt the same action again this turn. Discard down to your hand size.
As above, but tap the blocking minion.

Messages.Author: Rulemonger
Messages.Body:
> cauecoraini wrote:
> 1. Simple question: can I  Basic Bleed with a Ravnos, play red herring, then play computer hacking with another minion?
Yes.

> Does it not clash card text with  6.1.1 of rule book?
No. 6.1.1. says nothing about other minions.

> 2.  Still, can I Basic Bleed with a minion, play red herring and then computer hacking with the same minion?
No, by 6.1.1.

Messages.Author: cauecoraini
Messages.Body: thanks and sorry, messed the order of arguments

Messages.Author: Juggernaut1981
Messages.Body:
Red Herring prohibits another minion from taking the exact same identical action as the first minion.

NRA (6.1.1) prevents the one particular minion attempting multiple actions from the same class of actions, or actions with the exact same name.

Messages.Author: Rulemonger
Messages.Body:
> Juggernaut1981 wrote:
> NRA (6.1.1) prevents the one particular minion attempting multiple actions from the same class of actions, or actions with the exact same name.
6.1.1. prevents a minion from taking a second bleed in a turn.
6.1.6. and 6.1.7. prevents repeating certain other kinds of things.
